about.heading: Hey!
about.lead: I’m Eyad, a Senior UI/UX & Product Designer based in Alexandria, Egypt, currently leading design at Tritecs.
paragraphs: I design highly usable products for global clients across the USA, Europe and the Middle East, grounded in research, usability and scalable design systems.
I’ve trained and mentored 1,000+ UI/UX students at UX Gate, and I bring AI into my process with a focus on how people intuitively interact with intelligent systems.

statement: From research to release. I turn complex workflows, user needs and business goals into clear, usable and polished products, driven by evidence, structured systems and intentional design.

items.text: Managing and leading UX/UI design for globally distributed SaaS and digital products across the USA and Europe, from user flows and workflow design to wireframes, prototypes and close collaboration with product and engineering.
Managed UI/UX design for multinational pharmaceutical clients, optimizing user experiences to meet industry standards.
Leading projects with major external companies to enhance their products, and training and mentoring 1,000+ students in UI/UX, from research and wireframing to information architecture.
Designed the user experience for Match Koora, Hawwesh and other products through user research, wireframes and prototypes.
